program.name: ENS Service Provider Program, Season 2 (SPP2)
program.authority: ENS DAO through a ranked-choice social selection vote under the amended SPP2 allocation procedure, followed by executable stream implementation

governingPolicy.version: EP6.3 program plus EP6.5 amended selection procedure
governingPolicy.changeSummary: After applications were submitted and eligibility review had begun, the DAO amended the SPP2 voting and budget-allocation procedure through EP6.5 and MetaGov reopened a limited application edit window before the final selection vote.

rules.description: MetaGov publicly confirmed on the JustaName application thread that the application met SPP2 eligibility criteria; the amended facilitation plan states that all applications advancing to the final vote were eligible.

eligibility.rationale: JustaName's application thread contains an explicit MetaGov eligibility confirmation. Exact eligibility-check timestamp is not established.

evaluators.role: rank and select SPP2 service providers and budget options under the EP6.5 voting procedure

evidence.description: ENS governance documentation for passed EP6.5 amendment defining Copeland ranking and $4.5M allocation.
MetaGov amended facilitation plan stating EP6.5 governs the selection vote and all final-vote applications are eligible.
JustaName public SPP2 application with MetaGov eligibility confirmation and $300,000 basic budget listing in the EP6.10 index.
EP6.10 social selection proposal describing ranked-choice mechanics and listing JustaName.
EP6.13 executable SPP2 implementation naming Justaname at $300,000 annual allocation for a one-year stream.

criteria.name: Copeland pairwise ranking with average support as tiebreaker under EP6.5
criteria.scoreScale: ordinal funding-priority rank among budget entries; exact JustaName Copeland rank is not independently recomputed in this reconstruction

criteria.name: NONE BELOW approval cutoff and budget allocation under the $4.5M envelope

materialFindings.statement: MetaGov publicly confirmed that JustaName met the SPP2 eligibility criteria.
The public EP6.13 SPP2 implementation lists Justaname among funded providers at $300,000 for a one-year stream.
Public EP6.13 materials describe JustaName as a new SPP2 provider receiving a newly established stream.

evaluation.aggregateScale: No scalar applicant-merit score; the public decision used ranked pairwise voting and budget allocation.

decision.authority: ENS DAO SPP2 ranked-choice social selection (EP6.10) implemented by executable EP6.13 stream configuration
decision.rationale: JustaName passed eligibility, participated in the EP6.10 ranked-choice selection under EP6.5, and is listed in the EP6.13 implementation as a funded one-year provider at $300,000.
decision.decisionRule: Rank budget entries by Copeland pairwise results with average support as tiebreaker, then allocate in rank order subject to two-year eligibility/cap rules and the $4.5M total budget, stopping when the budget is fully allocated or NONE BELOW is reached.

challenge.scope: The reviewed public SPP2 governing and implementation artifacts do not identify a dedicated post-result factual or procedural correction process for an individual funded applicant. This is a public-evidence limitation, not a claim that no internal channel existed.

deliveryConditions.description: Operate as a funded SPP2 service provider under the one-year $300,000 stream established in the EP6.13 implementation, subject to program reporting and Stream Management Pod administration.
deliveryConditions.reviewWindow: SPP2 funded cycle / quarterly reporting practice for service providers
deliveryConditions.verificationMethod: Public program reporting and Stream Management Pod / Foundation administration under SPP2 terms.
deliveryConditions.verifier: ENS DAO Stream Management Pod and program facilitators according to public SPP2 terms
dependencies: Executable EP6.13 stream configuration and program onboarding
deliveryConditions.consequence: Stream administration may adjust or end streams under DAO/program processes; this reconstruction does not invent a JustaName-specific pause or termination event.

notes: Public-only retrospective reconstruction; this is not a contemporaneous institutional decision record.
Exact Copeland rank and pairwise tallies for JustaName are not independently recomputed here; funding is taken from the public EP6.13 implementation table.
governingPolicy.effectiveAt, eligibility.checkedAt, and decision.decidedAt remain null at schema-v0.1 precision.
spp.vote and unofficial stream-tracking repositories are not treated as cryptographic proofs in this case.
Reference-only remote sources are not represented as exact byte-preserved captures.
